name: llmhubpp
description: Desktop Obsidian plugin for chat, vault retrieval, workflows, and Safe Guard.

scripts.dev:langfuse: npm run generate:builtin-okf && node esbuild.config.mjs langfuse
scripts.build: npm run generate:builtin-okf && npm run generate:settings-search && npm run check:docs-mcp && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:legacy: npm run generate:builtin-okf && npm run check:docs-mcp && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production legacy
scripts.build:langfuse: npm run generate:builtin-okf && npm run check:docs-mcp && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production langfuse
scripts.preversion: node version-bump.mjs --check-next && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.check:docs-mcp: npm run generate:configuration && node scripts/check-docs-mcp.mjs && node --test scripts/help-links.test.mjs scripts/docs-mcp-contracts.test.mjs && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/configuration/mcp/discovery.test.ts src/configuration/probe.test.ts src/configuration/checks.test.ts

author: Llmhub++ contributors (original author: takeshy)
